tool_input.prompt: Latest React version and release date

tool_result_content:
The latest React version is **19.3**, released on **September 9, 2026** (v19.3.0). The page links to the [React 19.3 blog post](/blog/2026/09/09/react-19-3) and the [v19.3.0 changelog entry](https://github.com/react/react/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#1930-september-9-2026).

The docs at react.dev cover this version. Previous major versions are archived at `18.react.dev`, `17.react.dev`, `16.react.dev`, and `15.react.dev`.
